evals.prompt: Build a responsive landing page for an independent legal research studio. It should feel editorial rather than SaaS-generic, include a memorable hero, a case-notes section, a clear consultation call to action, and polished mobile behavior. Use the frontend stack already present in the repository.
evals.expected_output: A working, responsive page with a deliberate editorial art direction, distinctive typography and composition, accessible interaction states, and no generic template aesthetic.
expectations: The agent activates and reads the frontend-design SKILL.md before implementation.
The agent states or clearly embodies a specific visual direction tied to the audience and purpose.
The result uses a cohesive type, color, spacing, and motion system rather than framework defaults.
The page works at mobile and desktop widths and preserves keyboard-visible interaction states.
The agent does not load unrelated skill bodies unless the implementation actually requires them.

evals.prompt: Redesign the existing analytics dashboard so dense operational data is easy to scan without looking like a stock admin template. Preserve every current feature, improve hierarchy and empty/loading/error states, and add restrained motion that respects reduced-motion preferences.
evals.expected_output: A distinctive but usable dashboard redesign that preserves functionality, improves information hierarchy, and handles all important UI states accessibly.
expectations: The agent activates and reads the frontend-design SKILL.md before editing the interface.
Existing functionality and data interactions are preserved.
Loading, empty, error, hover, focus, and reduced-motion states are intentionally handled.
The composition avoids a predictable grid of interchangeable rounded cards.
Only frontend-design is activated for the visual redesign unless a separate backend change becomes necessary.

evals.prompt: Create a reusable React pricing comparison component for a privacy-focused product. Make the annual/monthly switch functional, highlight the recommended plan without a clichéd purple-gradient treatment, and ensure the comparison remains understandable on narrow screens and with a screen reader.
evals.expected_output: A production-ready, accessible pricing component with a distinctive visual concept, functioning billing control, and robust responsive behavior.
expectations: The agent activates and reads the frontend-design SKILL.md before implementation.
The billing-period control updates displayed prices and exposes correct accessible state.
The recommended tier is visually clear without relying on generic AI-style aesthetics.
The comparison remains usable on narrow screens and with keyboard and screen-reader navigation.
The agent does not activate backend-api-engineering for mocked or local pricing state.
